shared_or_similar_visual_information: Multiple filled pieces separated by unfilled parts of the surrounding figure. On the left, use the three gray triangles meeting the center, with white triangles between them. On the right, use the dark triangle at the left and dark parallelogram at the lower right of the tangram runner.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The fill selects three separate triangles whose areas contribute to the shaded fraction. Right image: The fill selects two separate tangram pieces for the shaded-area test.
Rationales: In each figure the fill specifies the components included in a total area. The unfilled pieces do not contribute to that total.
